changes.comment: A large vault now opens in the browser: every note rides one connection to the relay instead of one each, so a vault of more than a couple of hundred notes no longer runs into the browser's limit on simultaneous connections.
A first sync no longer makes the app sluggish while it waits for notes to arrive.
A relay that has gone quiet is reported rather than waited on: a first sync is given as long as it keeps making progress, and is given up on only once nothing has arrived for twenty seconds.
